about_h2: About Doug's 24 hour Towing & Recovery LLC
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. 129 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.1 out of 5. We work out of Elon and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Melissa Hebert
reviews.text: Doug and his team are incredibly prompt, professional, and kind. My son ended up stuck in a ditch during a bad storm, and they responded quickly and handled everything safely and efficiently. They got him out fast and made a stressful situation much easier. I’m very grateful for their help and would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: LeVan Moxley
reviews.text: 5 STARS for this service - The van I was driving blew a tire on I40 west on Saturday night at 8pm. I tried changing the tire but the previous shop had put the lugs on too tight and I couldn't get them to budge. I called Doug's and they sent someone out. He was there in 10 minutes. He was very helpful and had the old wheel off and the spare on in no time. He then followed us as we got back on I40 to make sure everything was OK. TOP NOTCH! Thanks Doug's for GREAT SERVICE!

reviews.author: Safety Reasons
reviews.text: Car was stolen police found car after 5, we try getting our car and was still charged a two day fee and I have a police report of my vehicle being stolen!!!!!! I am going to have to look into this because this not right at all!!!!!!!380 is what I am being charged but they say they service 24hours but yet refuse to let me get my car after 5 yesterday, false advertisement they first mistake with me!!!!! I will stop at nothing to see why they doing business the way they are!!!!!
